milestones.name: Map Unlock (Stage 1) - View at Shii
milestones.note: After offering enough Nerre to Shii, player can view the map by visiting him in The Spine.

milestones.name: Map Unlock (Stage 2) - Pause Menu Access
milestones.note: Second stage of map unlock allows map access from the pause menu at any time. Map only updates at network gates (save points).

zones.name: The Spine
zones.fingerprintHint: Large chained mechanical structure in background, snow-like ground, dark atmospheric interior. First save point is located here. Shii NPC is found just above it.
zones.note: Early game zone containing the first save point and the Shii NPC who unlocks the map.

abilities.name: Map
abilities.grants: Ability to view the game map, initially only at Shii's location, then from the pause menu globally.
abilities.note: Unlocked in two stages by offering Nerre to Shii. Map only updates when saving at a network gate. Crystallized Nerre is NOT accepted by Shii.

objectives.name: Unlock the Map
objectives.hopDescription: Return to Shii above the first save point in The Spine and offer him Nerre (earned by defeating enemies) until his pool is filled. Requires a few hundred Nerre total. Nerre lost on death is automatically sent to Shii's pool.
objectives.note: Map is offline by default in the pause menu. Shii will not speak much on first encounter — must return with Nerre. Crystallized Nerre is not accepted.
